channel.title: Tunis Desk
channel.description: A private daily round-up of Tunisian domestic politics, generated by Claude from Tunisian news sites.
channel.itunes:author: Tunis Desk

item.title: Tunis Desk – Friday 23 October 2026
item.description: Court of Cassation reportedly upholds sentences in the second conspiracy case, including twenty years for Rached Ghannouchi; deaths after security operations spark unrest in Ettadhamen and Jebiniana; parliament begins the two thousand and twenty-seven budget debate, with central bank borrowing and oil price questions; thousands march in Tunis against repression and impoverishment; Kais Saied on food sovereignty; Briefly: Sfax student strike, the Mohamed Yousfi case, the water crisis; And finally: Tunisian artists leave the country.

item.title: Tunis Desk – Thursday 22 October 2026
item.description: Running order: Military court jails opposition figure Olfa Hamdi for four years; Zied El-Heni terrorism trial postponed to 27 October; Protester dies in Menzel Bouzelfa after factory dispute; Saied at Council of Ministers on the 2027 finance bill and warnings of blackmail; Budget 2027: 9.8 billion dinars central bank facility; Nawaat investigation on the summer water crisis; Briefly: UGTT Nabeul, Tunis protest route, Ghar al-Dema arrests, sugar and flour supply; And finally: Deputy Ahmed Saidani's dream of a different Tunisia.

item.title: Tunis Desk – Wednesday 21 October 2026
item.description: Budget 2027: sixty-eight billion dinars and nine point eight billion from the Central Bank; Sumud flotilla activists get suspended sentences; thousands march in Tunis behind the UGTT, bar, LDH and journalists; Ayachi Hammami's family alleges isolation in prison; Kasserine lawyers threaten a strike over courts; Saied in Bizerte; Briefly: rain alert, sugar and flour, Sonede trafficking, joint custody bill; And finally: Tunis-Carthage taxi fares.

item.title: Tunis Desk – Tuesday 20 October 2026
item.description: Tunis Desk running order: Thousands march in Tunis and the UGTT warns the street is the table of dialogue; the two thousand and twenty-seven budget, including a nine point eight billion dinar interest-free Central Bank loan, and questions over growth and oil assumptions; Kais Saied in Bizerte; Inkyfada on prison deaths during the summer heatwave; Briefly: administrative simplification, sports law, price talks, teleworking; And finally: airport taxi fares.

item.title: Tunis Desk – Monday 19 October 2026
item.description: Thousands march in Tunis against repression and impoverishment, called by the U-G-T-T, lawyers, rights league and journalists; Khayam Turki's four-year sentence upheld on appeal; the two thousand and twenty-seven budget and its central bank financing; oil prices, a supplementary budget and the reserve ratio hike; journalists' union backs a general strike; briefly: Saied in Bizerte, hunger strikes, student elections; and finally, airport taxi fares.

item.description: Budget 2027: state spending, Central Bank financing and a first sukuk; Unions, lawyers and rights groups march in Tunis; Oil prices and the call for a supplementary budget; Kais Saied in Bizerte for Evacuation Day; Sugar and flour shortages; Briefly: Sousse arrests, procurement rules, plainclothes traffic police; And finally: airport taxi fares.
